title: Your Internet History is Ruining Your Career (3 Things HR Checks Behind Your Back)
description:
HR knows more about you than you think. 

Whether you're job hunting OR already clocked in — your internet history, social media, and digital footprint are being monitored. And most people have absolutely no idea how deep it goes.
I'm breaking down the 3 things HR and recruiters secretly check behind your back. From the Google search that happens before your interview even gets scheduled, to what your company can actually see on their Wi-Fi. Yes, including your Slack DMs.

What we're covering:
 The digital footprint mistakes that get your résumé quietly tossed before you hear back
 What HR and IT can actually track once you're hired (the fine print you didn't read)
 The "off-the-clock" social media behaviour that lands people in a surprise 4PM HR Zoom
This is the stuff nobody tells you. Consider this your warning.
 Grab my no-BS career advice book Clock In: https://emilydurham.org/clock-in
